loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

kind-dependencies:
    - post-beetmover-dummy

transforms:
    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_update_product_channel_version:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release:run_on_releases
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

attributes:
        shippable: true
    worker-type: shipit
    worker:
        implementation: shipit-update-product-channel-version
    scopes:
        by-release-level:
            production:
                - project:comm:thunderbird:releng:ship-it:server:production
                - project:comm:thunderbird:releng:ship-it:action:update-product-channel-version
            staging:
                - project:comm:thunderbird:releng:ship-it:server:staging
                - project:comm:thunderbird:releng:ship-it:action:update-product-channel-version
    shipping-phase: ship
    treeherder:
        symbol: Rel(up-chl-ver)
        kind: other
        tier: 1

tasks:
    thunderbird:
        run-on-releases: ["nightly"]
        run-on-projects: ["comm-central"]
        shipping-product: thunderbird

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Ship-It version-update task depends on post-beetmover-dummy, so it runs after archive upload rather than immediately after a build. It is restricted to Nightly on comm-central and uses shipping-phase ship with a shippable task. Production and staging server scopes differ, while the action scope is explicit. Review changed the loader and job vocabulary to the taskgraph transform loader and task form. The bug also required a scope grant in the separate CI configuration repository; the in-tree string alone cannot grant access. No task graph, archive upload or Ship-It call was executed.
title: Schedule Nightly version reporting after archive completion
